text: The Client shall pay a fixed fee of INR 2,50,000 for the Services. The Client shall pay each invoice within fifteen (15) days of receipt. Overdue amounts bear interest at 1.5% per month. 30% of the Fee is payable in advance.
The Client shall pay a reasonable fee within a reasonable time after completion of the Services.

All work product, whether or not related to the Services, and all pre-existing materials used, shall vest in the Client upon creation, perpetually and irrevocably. The Consultant waives all moral rights.
The Client may terminate at any time without notice or liability. The Consultant may not terminate before completion.
